correctness.rationale: Verified headline N(A0)=P^2 end-to-end. Bases/Hilbert (1,3,6,6,3), total 19, socle=all of degree 4 (level type 3) replayed exactly (stdlib script ALL CHECKS PASSED). Rebuilt M2(a,b,c) from monomial bases and checked all six rows against L=ax+by+cz multiplication modulo (x^3,y^3,z^3,xyz): matrix entries correct. Determinant cancellation verified both by hand case-split (row supports force exactly two permutations sigma=(0,1,3,2,5,4) sign + product a^2b^2c^2 and tau=(1,2,0,4,3,5) sign - product a^2b^2c^2, no other choice) and by 720-permutation exhaustion (exactly 2 nonzero terms, det identically 0). Hence rank<=5<6=min(dim A2,dim A3) at every [a:b:c], so every linear form fails WLP at 2->3 and N(A0)=P^2 (codim 0). M1 3x3 minors a^3,b^3,c^3 checked (rows (0,1,3),(1,2,4),(3,4,5)), so V(F1)=empty, consistent. All 36 5x5 minors verified nonzero monomials (each single permutation term), so generic rank exactly 5; rank<5 at special points would only strengthen N=P^2. Single-L ranks 1,3,5,3 at (1,1,1) and kernel vector (1,-1,1,-1,-1,1) for x^2-xy+y^2-xz-yz+z^2 checked by exact rational elimination. Jordan nullities 7,12,15,18,19 give block counts c=(7,5,3,3,1) hence [5,4,4,2,2,1,1] summing to 19, L^5=0!=L^4, replayed with Fractions. Proof vs computation properly separated in DRAFT; core det identity is hand-verifiable.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively, not by timestamp. Boij-Migliore-Miro-Roig-Nagel (1609.00952) completely describes line loci only for monomial complete intersections (Prop 3.1; e.g. (3,3,3) CI locus is a1a2a3=0, three lines) plus expected-codimension for general CI; states nothing about ACIs, so whole-plane locus for 4-generator ACI A0 not implied. Cook-Nagel (1507.03853) classifies type-two WLP via lozenge/lattice-path determinants; gives hold/fail criteria, no varying-[a:b:c] Fitting equations/codim/degree for any ACI. Booth-Vraciu (2603.11491) treats exactly the family I=(x^d1,y^d2,z^d3,x^a1y^a2z^a3), level case d_i-a_i=t, with hold/fail determinant in t and MMN-conjecture progress (for A0: a=(1,1,1),t=2 predicts general-L failure since t even, sum odd, a_i not distinct); inspected abstract, introduction, Conjecture 1.1, Thm 2.2/3.1/3.6: it publishes a fixed-general-L verdict polynomial, not P^2 Fitting-minor locus equations or codim/degree for the symmetric cubic, and does not state det M2==0 identically or N=P^2. Marangone (2404.16238) treats conics (P^5) for general CI, not ACI line loci. Whole-plane failure (every L fails) is strictly stronger than general-L failure and is not a plug-in of any cited product/determinant formula; the a^2b^2c^2-a^2b^2c^2 two-term cancellation is a new exact computation for this ideal.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object: N(A0)=P^2 (codim 0, whole plane) for the minimal highly-symmetric 4-generator cubic ACI A0=Q[x,y,z]/(x^3,y^3,z^3,xyz), motivated before computation by the Boij et al. non-Lefschetz-locus program and the open level-ACI classification, with stated downstream reuse (locus-strata vs Jordan type, jumping-locus comparison, WLP-testing regression). Value was not known or mechanically implied (nearest CI analogue gives three lines, not whole plane; ACI hold/fail criteria do not give locus scheme). A future researcher can reasonably need the precise fact (which degree fails, that no L is Lefschetz, kernel witness, Hilbert/socle, Jordan partition [5,4,4,2,2,1,1]). This is an eligible narrow exact datum under the shared standard, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; certification is accompanied by a two-line hand proof and full replay artifacts.
